title: Victoria St between Bay Rd and Torrens St
why: The largest single hotspot today: closely spaced side streets and car-park accesses on a one-lane-each-way street. No tested option fixes it; N8 (left-turn lanes) was built for it and did not help.
junctions_used: Victoria St nodes between lon 138.6125 and 138.6200 (as the S7 diagnosis), incl. victoria_oval, victoria_granite, the IGA car-park access and the Liberty service station

scenario_descriptions.bp: Brent's package (four-lane ring road, two-lane McCracken roundabout, roundabout slip lanes)
scenario_descriptions.cp: Council's town-centre package (30 km/h centre, shared zones, one-way loop, signals)
scenario_descriptions.n7: N7: roundabouts at Armstrong/Crozier, Armstrong/Greenhills and Hindmarsh/Grantley
scenario_descriptions.n8: N8: left-turn lanes on Victoria St into Oval Rd and the IGA car park
scenario_descriptions.n9: N9: Crozier Rd turn lanes at Armstrong Rd + Hindmarsh Rd / Grantley Ave roundabout
